name: get_clickpipe
description: Returns the full definition of one ClickPipe on a ClickHouse service: name, description, state, replica scaling, source settings (Kafka, object storage, Kinesis, or Postgres), destination database and table definition, field mappings, and creation and update times. If the lookup fails, result is an error object with status "error" and a message.

clickPipeId.description: ClickPipe to retrieve. Use the id of an entry returned by list_clickpipes for the same service.

organizationId.description: Organization that owns the service. Use the id of an organization returned by get_organizations.

serviceId.description: ClickHouse service that owns the ClickPipe. Use the id of a clickhouse-type service returned by get_services_list.
